senses.gloss: m., pl. רַּבְלוּלִין (denom. of דְּבֵלָה, cmp. σῦκον, συκῆ, ficus) piles, excrescences; trnsf. lumps.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 9:2">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. IX, 2</cite> <he>היו ד׳ יוצאין וכ׳</he> (cmp. <cite ref="M02106"><he>מֵעַיִין</he></cite> <cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 9:2">ib.</cite>) if lumps of upholstery protrude from the couch.

<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 7:11">Ib. VII, 11</cite> <he>היו ד׳ … הימנה</he> if lumps or irregular pieces of reeds hang down from the matting.—Denom. <cite ref="M00258"><he>מְדוּבְלָל</he></cite>
<cite ref="Mishnah Bekhorot 3:4">Bekh. III, 4</cite> <he>הצמר המ׳</he> (Talm. ed. 25ᵇ <he>המדולדל</he>) the clumps in the wool.—
senses.label: a

units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sukkah 2:2">Succ. II, 2</cite> <he>סוכה המְדוּבְלֶלֶת</he> a miserable looking Succah, expl. ib. 22ᵃ (by Rab) as <he>ענייה</he> or <he>מדולדלת</he> (Y. ib. 52ᵇ bot. <he>מדוללת</he>, v. <cite ref="D00841"><he>דָּלַל</he></cite> a. <cite ref="D00807"><he>דִּלְדֵּל</he></cite>) beggarly, thinned; (by Samuel) as <he>קנה עולה וקנה יורד</he> or <he>מבולבלת</he> disarranged.
senses.label: b
